title: Bobukami na Libongo
intro: Otelemi likolo ya zelo ya libongo oyo babosani, epai wapi mbonge ezali kolobaloba na mongongo ya nse ya lisanga moko oyo emekami na etinda ya bonzambe. Mopepe ezali kilo na bokundoli ya bobukami oyo ememaki na mbongwana ya kokamwa. Milimo yango ezalaki banani, mpe komekama na bango ezalaki ndenge nini?
clues: Tozalaki lisanga oyo ezwaki etinda ya polele uta na Nkolo na biso, nzokande tozwaki banzela ya koboya yango.
Tozalaki kofanda pene na esika moko ya mai, mpe bomoi na biso etalelaki bikelamu na yango.
Momekano moko eyaki epai na biso mokolo oyo bapesaki biso mitindo ete tóboya misala ya mokili.
Bikelamu ya mai eyaki epai na biso na motango monene kaka na mokolo wana, komekaka biso koleka mpiko.
Tozwaki mayele moko ya mayele mabe mpo na kokima molongo ya bonzambe, kokanisaka ete tokoki koleka mobeko yango na mayele.
Kobuka mobeko na biso ememaki na mbongwana moko ya nsɔni; tokomaki ba singes oyo batyolamaki na etinda ya Allah.

Limpinga ya bandɛkɛ etindaki bango mpo na kobundisa bango

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
